decision.observation: 5 mph, gear R, all dots dark, no red X. The car is back on the tarmac facing up the lane, white posts on both sides, a hay bale stack on the left verge, and the lane bending up-left then curving right past a blue puddle toward the top of frame.
decision.hypothesis: The car is already aimed up the lane; the remaining problem is only that it is still rolling backwards. A plain W hold should engage forward gear and carry it along the lane without needing steering.
decision.memory: S+A paid off: back on the lane facing uphill with a bale stack on the left. Reverse-only steers are fine when the car is rolling.
